title: Unity reportedly in $25B buyout talks with EA's owners
subject: unity
description:
Would a Unity buyout worry you as a developer or player? 👇

Reuters reported on November 5, 2026 that Silver Lake and Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, the group that took EA private for $55 billion, approached Unity about a takeover valuing the game engine company at about $25 billion. No deal has been signed and Unity declined to comment. Unity's Q3 results showed $122 million net income on $622 million revenue.

Sources: Reuters via PC Gamer (Nov 5, 2026), Wccftech (Nov 6, 2026), KeenGamer (Nov 6, 2026), Unity Q3 2026 results

scenes.text: The group that bought EA reportedly wants Unity next.
Reuters says Silver Lake and Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund approached Unity in recent weeks.
Two sources put the valuation at about $25 billion. No deal has been signed, and Unity declined to comment.
Silver Lake already owns about 8% of Unity, and its CEO Egon Durban sits on Unity's board.
The same day, Unity posted its first profitable quarter since going public in 2020, earning $122 million.
